comments: Input facts: backing requires at least one reversing road user; ego is the car responder and agent1 is the initiator, with the allowed car type selected. Assumptions: agent1 starts stationary 14-18 m ahead, faces the lane direction, and reverses with throttle 0.15-0.25; ego approaches at 3-4 m/s and brakes at center distance 9-11 m with brake 0.7-0.9. Both start in the same lane on an approximately straight segment. The initiating event is agent1 reversing toward ego; ego reacts to proximity. A conflict opportunity, rather than a required collision, is intended.
